note: No zoning district layer found for Kent County TX. ArcGIS search for zoning returned nothing for Kent County. Texas counties have very limited land-use authority; the county issues permits only for unincorporated areas, and no zoning map or service was found for the county or for Jayton, its only incorporated city (county seat). Commercial Kent County GIS data (texascountygisdata) lists parcels and city limits only, with no zoning attribute.
